title: Debt Avalanche vs Snowball: Pick One Today
hook_text: AT 24% APR YOUR DEBT DOUBLES EVERY 3 YEARS

beats.say: At 24% interest, the Rule of 72 means your debt doubles in just 3 years.
beats.visual: A single calculator resting on a dark wooden desk under harsh overhead light, shot from above.

beats.say: You're bleeding cash every single month and standing still.
beats.visual: A close-up of a hand tightly gripping a pen over a blank white notepad, dark moody shadows.

beats.say: Step one. List every single credit card balance and its exact interest rate.
beats.visual: A stack of plain white envelopes sitting on a minimalist concrete surface, sharp focus.

beats.say: Step two. Pick your strategy today or you'll stay trapped.
beats.visual: A dark coffee mug sitting next to a closed laptop lid on a textured gray table.

beats.say: Choose the avalanche method to attack the highest rate first.
beats.visual: A steep concrete staircase viewed from the bottom looking up, dramatic lighting.

beats.say: Or pick the snowball method to clear the smallest balance first.
beats.visual: Small smooth river stones piled neatly on a slate tile, soft natural side light.

beats.say: Remember, a $3,000 credit card at 24% APR paying only the minimum takes 183 months.
beats.visual: A vintage mechanical clock face ticking in low light, blurred background.

beats.say: That minimum payment trap costs you $4,887 in pure interest alone.
beats.visual: A dark metallic vault door partially open, throwing a sliver of light across the floor.

beats.say: Step three. Route every extra dollar to that single target account.
beats.visual: A hand sliding a blank white card across a dark wooden tabletop.

beats.say: But here's the part nobody mentions about paying off debt.
beats.visual: An empty highway stretching into a foggy horizon at dusk, moody teal tones.

beats.say: The math says avalanche wins, but psychology says snowball keeps you alive.
beats.visual: Two identical brass keys resting on a dark slate surface side by side.

beats.say: Pick the one you will actually stick to, because at 24% APR...
beats.visual: A finger poised right above the Enter key of a mechanical keyboard in dim light.

caption:
Stop letting interest eat your paycheck. Pick a method today.

#debtfree #moneyhacks #personalfinance #financialfreedom #smartmoney
description: Compare the debt avalanche and debt snowball methods. Learn how to pick the right strategy, stop the minimum payment trap, and take control of your interest today.
first_comment: Are you team avalanche (highest rate) or team snowball (smallest balance)?
